items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All three iterate-spec ACs (mini-plan persistence, review-findings durability + SubagentStop backstop, B1 resume via reviews.json) implemented; two explicitly out-of-scope items (widening the Mini-Plan trigger table, giving reviewers Write access) were declined per the spec, not silently added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: render_iterate_progress() distinguishes ReviewRecordError (unreadable/malformed) from a missing record instead of conflating them; write-review-payload-on-stop.py never blocks (bad stdin, missing transcript, no run_id, non-JSON reply all no-op, always exit 0).

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user-input surfaces, SQL, HTML, or secrets touched — this change reads/renders internal iterate-lifecycle JSON/markdown artifacts only.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert on rendered output/CLI stdout, not internals; each new behavior has both a happy-path (interrupted/complete) and an error-path (unreadable/missing/not-due-yet) case.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: reviews.json is a small, fixed-shape file read once per render call; the SubagentStop hook reads one bounded transcript file with retry/backoff, matching the existing write-section-on-stop.py pattern.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All new files live in the existing tests/scripts-hooks conventions; none exceeds 300 lines (largest new file is 237). Two pre-existing grandfathered files (test_generate_session_handoff.py, test_spec_checks.py) were kept at their exact anti-ratchet baseline by splitting new coverage into sibling files instead of extending them.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: reviews.json's producer/consumer pair is unchanged (read-only here) and documented in the iterate spec's Affected Boundaries table. Round-trip evidence: test_compaction_state_audit_acceptance.py drives a real fixture write followed by two independent real subprocess reads (record_review_pass.py show; the Stop hook); test_review_payload_on_stop.py covers fenced/raw JSON and legacy gates.spec parsing. Not a hand-typed text format like .env, so the full BOM/CRLF probe checklist is lower-relevance; the applicable round-trip is what's tested.
